rules: Every product must resolve to exactly one canonical department before Stylist sees it.
Every product must resolve to a canonical category or TAXONOMY_REVIEW; provider category names never create new HUNT departments automatically.
Subcategory is optional and must not be invented when no canonical deeper level exists.
Country shelf eligibility is evaluated after taxonomy; a product may exist in one country shelf and be absent in another.
BOOM Stylist may rank and arrange only products already eligible for that exact country/department/category shadow shelf.
BOOM Stylist may not change department/category identity, price, stock, shipping truth, policy status or provider truth.
Complete-the-look may reference another department only as a labeled complement; the referenced product keeps its own canonical department/category.
Cinematic presentation never changes taxonomy or Product Truth.
No autonomous Production reorder, publish, checkout activation or fulfillment.

allowed: shadow reorder inside same country + department + category
build complete-the-look relationships while preserving source taxonomy
optimize visual rhythm, density and light/dark presentation
abstain when category or visual confidence is low
forbidden: move product to a different canonical department to improve aesthetics
override Product Truth, spec, compatibility, authenticity or shipping gates
